data.name: Divija
data.long_meaning: Divija is a Sanskrit and Hindi name meaning 'Divine Goddess' or 'Shining One'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'diva', meaning 'heavenly' or 'divine'. This name is often given to girls born during auspicious occasions, as it is believed to bring blessings and good fortune.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divija represents the divine feminine and the divine light within each of us. It is a reminder to shine our light brightly and to trust in the divine guidance and protection.
data.numerology_meaning: Divija is a name with a strong vibration of creativity, self-expression, and personal growth. It is a name that encourages one to follow their passions and to share their talents with the world.
